note: A savory pie filled with seasoned pork, commonly eaten cold in Britain; recipes vary by region.

senses.pat: a slice of pork pie · traditional pork pie · serve pork pie cold

Tiệm bánh làm bánh nhân thịt heo với vỏ bột nước nóng.
